digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit dispatch-triggered Verified workflow, not tickets-branch pushes, saturated the Actions pool during 2026-08-12/13 incident with seven patchsets queued across five minutes reaching 22 waiting jobs and 873s max runner wait.

Current per-run job-slot cost is 17 jobs for full route with no mutation shards and up to 24 jobs with all seven mutation shards selected; peak simultaneous demand is 19 jobs (13-way fan-out after classify stage).

Organization holds Free plan with 20 total and 5 macOS concurrent job limits; repository-local measurement shows contention during independent-change bursts but org-wide queue depth is not directly observable via available API scope.

Four mutually exclusive first-move remediation options exist: demand reduction via preflight bundling and mutation-matrix cap (Option A—recommended), coalesce superseded patchsets via debounce (Option B—low incremental value), move macOS to branch-health schedule (Option C—weakens pre-merge coverage), or upgrade organization plan (Option D—high recurring cost).
